description: Extract the text of a PDF with lines and paragraphs rebuilt (right-to-left Arabic/Hebrew lines in reading order), as plain text or Markdown, with optional page separators and reflow (join lines, mend hyphenated words). Returns per-page word counts and flags pages with no text layer (scans: this tool does no OCR). Supports page ranges and passwords. Give "output" to write a .txt/.md file instead of returning the text inline. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-to-text/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

format.description: "text" or "markdown" (## Page N headings, reflowed paragraphs).

maxChars.description: Cut the inline text after this many characters (the file output is never cut).

output.description: Write the text to this file (or folder ending in "/") instead of returning it inline.

pages.description: Pages to read: 1-based list like "1-3, 5, 8-" ("5-" = to the end, "-3" = first three, "3-1" = reversed). Also "all", "odd", "even", "last". Empty = all pages.

password.description: Password, if the PDF is protected.

perPage.description: Also return each page's text separately.

reflow.description: Join the lines of each paragraph and mend words split by a hyphen.

separators.description: Put a "——— Page N ———" line before each page. Default true.

name: pdf_to_text
title: PDF to text
